# Support

Please open an [issue](https://github.com/DDinVA/grabit/issues/new/choose)
for bugs or feature requests, or start a
[discussion](https://github.com/DDinVA/grabit/discussions) for open-ended
questions.

For security issues, use the [security advisory](https://github.com/DDinVA/grabit/security/advisories/new)
channel instead. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
